title: Upper façades from two street panoramas
summary: At two ordinary addresses, two panoramic photographs agree on a small portion of a mapped wall. The game draws the observed brickwork and windows on the solid building. A third camera at each site supplied the comparison photographs.
measurement: Two of seven address searches yielded accepted wall detail. The native 900 × 600 control rendered identically before and after each test. Existing building dimensions and the surrounding street remain approximate.

images.caption: Iowa City, Iowa. 33,611 visible wall pixels. Mean RGB error fell from 34.32 to 22.32 on a 0–255 scale. The brick color is closer. The pixel test did not establish better alignment of individual windows. Photographs by slinky309 via Panoramax, CC BY-SA 4.0.

Minneapolis, Minnesota. 11,575 visible wall pixels. Mean RGB error fell from 38.11 to 29.56 on a 0–255 scale. Correlation of local light/dark detail rose from 0.024 to 0.434 in the tall, narrow strip. Photographs by slinky309 via Panoramax, CC BY-SA 4.0.

credit: All six source photographs by slinky309 via Panoramax, CC BY-SA 4.0. The two derived textures and both comparison sheets carry the same license. OpenStreetMap contributors supply the mapped footprints via OpenFreeMap.
